text: With roots and allies among the most powerful and upright nobility, this Lord doesn't often meddle with unstable mercs. Who heard that.
Perhaps risen from the lowest ranks, this commander is in his own environment when leading mercenary companies, just as a dolphin plays on the waves.
Master of one of those small domains that make the Border Princes, this Lord can rely on his citizens and local supporters.
Well-used to fierce struggles against countless invaders, this Lord has earned the trust of the Rangers.
